entities.name: Ilharg
entities.description: The Boar God of Ravnica, prophesied by Gruul druids to bring the End-Raze.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Plane Ilharg is prophesied to trample.

entities.name: End-Raze
entities.description: Prophesied apocalypse in which Ilharg tramples Ravnica's cities.

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: Clans whose druids of the Old Ways prophesy the End-Raze.

entities.name: Old Ways
entities.description: Druids of the Gruul Clans who prophesy the End-Raze.

events.summary: Gruul druids prophesy that Ilharg will bring the End-Raze and trample Ravnica's skylines.
events.quote: They cling to the idea of a coming apocalypse, the End-Raze

relations.note: Their druids prophesy him as bringer of the End-Raze.
relations.quote: as prophesied by the druids of the Old Ways from the Gruul Clans
